phase: Household Consumption — Borrower-Burden Population Alignment Gate
purpose: Determine whether the observed BNR housing-loan DSTI level series is population- and instrument-aligned with the registered aggregate household-consumption mechanism before any candidate-family preregistration or estimation.

registered_mechanism.reference_sector_definition: Households and non-profit institutions serving households (NPISH), S1M = S14 + S15
registered_mechanism.target_scope: aggregate sector consumption, not borrower-subpopulation consumption

candidate_burden_measure.source: BNR Bank Lending Survey publication-text DSTI levels
candidate_burden_measure.population: borrowers represented in respondent-bank housing/mortgage-loan portfolios

variants.interpretation: origination-state burden for housing loans granted in the quarter
burden measure for outstanding/total housing-loan portfolios

source_comparison.conclusion: The observed BNR housing-loan DSTI levels are scientifically valid borrower-burden observables but are not directly admissible as the debt_service_ratio driver in the registered aggregate S1M consumption equation. A targeted official-source screening found no observed public bridge, aligned borrower-consumption target or Romania common microdata frame that closes this population boundary.

screened_source_summary.ECB_HFCS: Conceptually suitable household finance/consumption microdata. BNR is an HFCN member institution, but Romania is not identified as a participating country dataset in the 2017, 2021 or latest 2023 HFCS waves.
screened_source_summary.INS_ABF_TEMPO: Quarterly household budget/consumption source exists, but no public mortgage-borrower-status breakdown or DSTI-consumption linkage was identified.
screened_source_summary.ECB_CES: High-frequency spending/income survey, but no Romania country series was identified and it would not itself map mortgage-borrower DSTI to S1M consumption.

borrowing_rate_alignment.household_consumption_loan_rate: Would align to consumer-credit pricing but not to the housing-loan DSTI instrument boundary.
borrowing_rate_alignment.household_house_purchase_rate: Would align more closely to the housing-loan DSTI instrument boundary but would still leave the aggregate-consumption population mismatch unresolved.
borrowing_rate_alignment.synthetic_weighted_rate: Not authorized without a preregistered weighting population and exact compatible exposure weights.

admissible_reopen_paths.requirement: Identify an observed Romania burden measure whose population and debt boundary are defensibly aligned with aggregate S1M household consumption.
admissible_reopen_paths.effect: May permit a new aggregate-consumption candidate-family measurement contract; does not itself authorize estimation.

admissible_reopen_paths.requirement: Identify an observed consumption/income target for a housing-borrower population aligned to the BNR DSTI boundary.
admissible_reopen_paths.effect: Would define a different empirical target/mechanism and requires separate preregistration; it may not silently replace the registered aggregate mechanism.

admissible_reopen_paths.requirement: Retain independently observed evidence capable of mapping housing-loan borrower burden to the aggregate consumption population without synthetic residual allocation.
admissible_reopen_paths.effect: Only after the bridge is frozen may the housing-loan DSTI candidate be reconsidered for aggregate consumption.

insufficient_reopen_evidence: A longer housing-loan DSTI time series by itself.
High correlation between housing-loan DSTI and aggregate consumption.
Selecting the mortgage borrowing rate because it improves fit.
Using housing-loan share of bank credit without a borrower-to-aggregate consumption mapping.
Combining housing and consumer-loan rates or DSTI measures with post-hoc weights.
Relabelling S1M aggregate consumption as mortgage-borrower consumption.
